privateSourceSummary: 建议保持创作者侧 TS/JS API，先封装现有 C++ 原生运行时，再用 Rust 替换边界清楚的新模块；语言更换本身不构成性能提升证据。
内部档案角色 S012 显示 V8 与 JSVM 适配路径并存，默认构建选择 JSVM；第三方版本标记和链接关系仅经静态核对，实际运行与性能尚未验证。
GPU 后端候选分层比较：现有 GLES 可先评估 ANGLE 兼容路径，现代路径比较 wgpu 与 Dawn，需要直接 D3D11 覆盖时同时比较 bgfx；以固定版本、相同混合场景与宿主共享设备验收决定。
NativeSDK 与 NativeApp 共用核心，分别声明设备拥有或借用模式；TS 到原生采用批量版本协议、有限缓冲、generation/epoch/lease/fence 和错误恢复。
V8 升级作为兼容与维护专项；iOS 系统 JSC、V8 jitless、QuickJS 和 Hermes 均是待测候选，运行模式与商店准入分别核验。
此结论只提出 0.6 候选设计，不新增产品实现或验证通过声明；证据在内部资料中保存。

languageDecision.inference: Retain/wrap validated C++ first; add Rust modules at explicit owned-data boundaries. Choose Rust for new lifetime-sensitive modules or a wgpu pilot when team/build evidence supports it; rewrite only modules whose behavior and measured cost justify replacement.
languageDecision.rustBenefits: Compile-time ownership/borrowing and typed contracts can reduce some memory/lifetime/data-race classes in safe Rust; may help AI-generated implementation review. Existing C++/FFI/unsafe and GPU resource state still need explicit contracts.
languageDecision.noAutomaticPerformance: C++ and Rust both support ahead-of-time native code and non-GC ownership. Language substitution alone does not reduce draw calls, overdraw, CPU layout, texture upload, JS GC, bridge crossings or device synchronization. Data layout, algorithms, allocations, release optimizations and target builds decide costs.
firstModules: Packet decoder/validation with bounded counts and lengths
Resource handles/generation/epoch bookkeeping and lifecycle ownership
Asset transforms and deterministic offline pipelines
retainInitially: V8/JSVM C++ embedding and generated bindings
Platform shell, input/IME, audio/video and host SDK adapters
Existing proven rendering/text paths as comparison and fallback

layeredCandidate.publicContract: Creator-facing TS/JS APIs plus versioned scene/asset/material/animation/HostCaps schema. Rust/C++/VM/backend choices remain behind it.
layers: TS semantic scene/UI/animation/resource orchestration and AI/editor command APIs
Versioned bulk render/resource/event packets and native host contract
Replaceable VM adapter with job scheduling, error, GC/root, buffer ownership and host capabilities
Backend-neutral RHI/render graph consuming ready handles with ordered UI/2D+3D passes
One native GPU device/queue/surface owner for a host; tested adapter for shared host resources
Platform shells: embeddable NativeSDK, standalone NativeApp, desktop platform/packaging adapter
sdkModes: Owned mode: SDK owns device/surface/queue; host owns app window/lifecycle and calls agreed frame entry
Borrowed mode: host owns compatible device/queue/targets; SDK uses documented lease/import and state/sync boundary; if unsupported reject or explicit offscreen copy fallback
abiRules: External native SDK uses versioned C ABI, opaque handles and POD or byte slices; never public C++ STL objects, Rust Vec/trait objects, v8::Local handles or native implementation types
Internal CXX may help generated Rust/C++ interop but does not substitute for stable SDK contract
Allocator ownership and create/destroy must remain same side; errors/status and callbacks are explicit; no panic/C++ exception unwinds across SDK ABI
packetRules: Batch updates by frame/island/resource class; no sync per-property getter or setter across JS/native hot path
Header includes protocol version, byte length/count, frame sequence, scene/device epoch and target capabilities
Reject oversized/truncated/overflow/misaligned inputs before pointer casts; bounded queue/inflight bytes with backpressure and explicit dropped-state recovery
Handles carry id+generation; scene/device epochs invalidate stale callbacks; recreated native scene is snapshot+delta mirror, with one authoritative semantic state
JS ArrayBuffer borrowed only for call lifetime or explicit pinned backing-store lease; async/GPU use needs owned copy or retained lease until completion
Fence-backed resource retirement and release acknowledgements; an epoch check does not prove all outstanding GPU or foreign-thread use has completed
Source/API compatibility includes event order, transforms, hit tests, layout, clipping, text/IME, resource races and disposal, not only TypeScript typings

validationPlan.status: Proposed future gates only; no new probe or product implementation in this task
sequence: Inventory delivered app runtime/build settings; close dependency/source/binary provenance and establish currently working C++ reference
Freeze TS semantics and versioned host/packet contracts; replay old project's behavior and mixed UI2D/light3D reference scenes
Change one axis per comparison: VM version or VM implementation, GPU backend, or Rust module; keep rollback path and asset/quality parity
Measure complex UI (CJK/emoji/IME/virtual lists/nested masks), 2D skeleton/frame animation and light3D mixed scene; test resource replacement/unload/background/device loss

SDK gates: owned/borrowed device, host update order, single queue owner, imports/fences, host teardown under GPU load, no callback after shutdown; desktop keyboard/controller/windows/resize and platform integration

Record release build/device/OS/driver/VM/backend versions; cold/warm startup, JS+layout/preparation/bridge/GC costs, CPU/GPU frame p50/p95/p99, input latency, package/memory/VRAM/peak transient upload, 20-30min sustained stability
Acceptance thresholds chosen after baseline and product device profile; no speed multiplier or timeline invented
